title: Frontend records name the project's own browser gate
body:
Outcome: the adopted frontend records name the project's own browser gate when one exists (for boilerplate-2026, `mise run check:browser`, which needs DDEV, fixtures and `mise run build`) and tell an agent to run it instead of a hand-written Playwright script.
Proof: `krn standards query "frontend browser verification"` prints a record that mentions the project gate command; a records test asserts the record text.
Evidence: probe on the real site, exit 0, 433 PASS lines, 0 FAIL, 112 s, covering layout at 320/390/1280, console, origins, axe, LCP, nav and motion, a superset of s-frontend-browser-gate-axe.
